Subject: Final Notice — Economic Adjustment Payment Verification Required

Dear Resident,

The National Economic Assistance Processing Center is contacting you regarding an economic adjustment payment associated with recent changes in inflation and household purchasing costs.

Our records indicate that you may qualify for a $2,847.63 Economic Cost-of-Living Adjustment based on information contained in our preliminary eligibility database. This payment is intended to assist qualifying residents who have experienced increased expenses related to housing, transportation, food, utilities, and other essential goods.

Your application has already passed the initial eligibility screening. However, payment release is currently pending verification of your personal and financial information.

To prevent delays, you must complete the verification process within 24 hours.

During verification, you will be asked to provide:

- Full legal name
- Date of birth
- Residential address
- Social Security number
- Bank name
- Bank account number
- Debit-card information
- Online banking username and password
- One-time verification code sent to your phone

The verification process is required because recent economic assistance programs have experienced increased fraudulent claims. Providing complete information allows our automated system to confirm that the payment is being issued to the correct individual.

IMPORTANT: Do not close this notification or attempt to submit your application through another website. Applications submitted through third-party websites may be rejected by our processing system.

Your payment is currently being held under reference EAP-472918563.

If verification is not completed before the deadline, your payment may be canceled and your application may be returned to the general processing queue. Reinstatement may require an additional administrative review.

Because economic conditions continue to change rapidly, payment amounts may also be adjusted after the verification period. Completing verification now will preserve your currently calculated payment amount.

To continue, use the secure verification portal associated with your application.

VERIFY PAYMENT NOW

If you believe you received this notification in error, contact the Economic Assistance Processing Desk immediately and provide your reference number.

Please do not reply to this message with financial information.

Regards,
Economic Adjustment Payment Processing Center
Financial Assistance Verification Division
